slowest_experiments.experiment: V600 branch retirement and evidence contract

summary: Four entries completed within 0.7 minutes, and three were compute-bound. Tokenizer-aware nuisance and split preregistration led at 0.64 minutes; no phase data explains its cost. Compute execution did not trigger the GPU-idle condition, and the records do not show concurrent model loading that would require DualGPURunner.
bottlenecks_identified: Modification-time reconstruction exposes the 0.64-minute critical path but contains no phase boundaries that can identify its cause.
The accelerator report is a point sample, so its 71% utilization reading cannot be assigned to an individual compute entry.
A launch record for model count and runner choice is absent. DualGPURunner eligibility therefore has no data available this milestone.
The single Python inference process has no batch-size receipt, which prevents verification of the reported question-collation opportunity.
improvements_suggested: Introduce configurable question collation with 8-16 items per forward pass in the single-process inference path.
Capture monotonic phase clocks plus accelerator memory and utilization samples bounded to each compute task.
Write a launch receipt for model count, batch size, GPU assignment, and runner choice. Permit DualGPURunner only for 2 or more simultaneous model loads.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Collate 8-16 questions for each forward pass made by the single inference process.
Replace modification-time-only reconstruction with phase clocks and accelerator samples scoped to task lifetime.
Persist launch-time model count and runner selection, and reserve DualGPURunner for 2 or more concurrent model loads.
meta_reflection: The evidence supports accelerator engagement, not full efficiency: a point sample showed 71% utilization and 96% memory use on GPU 1, without a task-window trace. Model concurrency was not recorded, so the runner question has no data available this milestone. A before-and-after timing trial is required before claiming savings above 0%.
